items.summary:
Ukraine’s expanding use of drones at all ranges has changed the war’s momentum. Can these strikes produce lasting advantages on the battlefield? Will this force Russia to escalate? Mike Kofman and Dara Massicot join Ryan to discuss.This episode is brought to you by Booz Allen.
